name: app-bad-channel-temp
summary: Marks bad channels in a raw MEG/EEG .fif file from the status column of a BIDS channels.tsv, using MNE-Python.
description: Reads the raw recording and the BIDS channels.tsv from the channels input, sets info['bads'] to every channel whose status is 'bad' (and that exists in the data), and saves the raw file. Use it to carry bad-channel annotations from BIDS sidecars into MNE data before filtering, Maxwell filtering or interpolation. The repository has no README.

inputs.description: Continuous MEG/EEG recording in MNE raw .fif format.
BIDS sidecar files for the recording; the code uses channels.tsv (name and status columns).
inputs.requirements: channels.tsv must contain a status column with 'bad' for bad channels.

outputs.description: Raw data (raw.fif) with info['bads'] set from channels.tsv.

failure_modes.fix: Provide a channels input that includes channels.tsv.
